method: a genuine Avito js/items response captured from a residential session on 2026-11-06 (50 hits, 2 with isReserved=true); trimmed to the first hit with isReserved=false and the first with isReserved=true, each reduced to the keys the parser reads; totalCount as served. De-identified: ids, URLs and titles are fictional, the location name is the city only, and every seller, phone, image and gallery key is dropped; prices, location id and timestamps are as served. No entry was invented or copied.

ground_truth.note: availability per hit: active (isReserved=false), reserved (isReserved=true); the default include_inactive=true keeps both, include_inactive=false keeps 1 and reports excluded_inactive=1
